text: Implemented the public Mvpa facade over specify, bind, plan, execute, and collect with exact associated result types. An out-of-package suite defines independent predictive and relational estimands, compiler instances, task kernels, typed results, axis-stage rejection, and role/capability rejection without internal access or a registry. Full MVPA gates passed JVM 191/191 and Scala.js 191/191; focused post-audit execution tests passed 5/5 on each platform; diff-check and escape-hatch audit are clean.
